description: What a buy or a sell of any BNB Chain token would get right now, through the pool that pays most (`bestPrice` says which and by how much), with the price impact, taxes and the site fee. Refused past 50% price impact unless maxPriceImpactPct allows more. Sends nothing.

amount.description: buy: the pair currency to spend; sell: whole tokens to sell

maxPriceImpactPct.description: refuse past this price impact, in percent; default 50

name: quote
